title: Dionne Warwick Reservations for Two Album CD Music 1987 Arista Records
descriptionText: The product is the CD album "Reservations for Two" by soul singer Dionne Warwick, released in 1987 under the Arista Records label. This album features musical style categorized under Musicals, with a Soul genre. With its romantic title and classic soul sound, this album is sure to enchant listeners with its timeless music and captivating performances by Dionne Warwick.
